scope: JS logic, real Chromium touch/layout and mock native PDF/storage bridge, native UI/haptics/recovery stubs, production PDF geometry/cache methods with stubs, actual Android SDK compile and signed APK build.
limitations: PdfRenderer, Canvas, Android picker and MediaStore were not executed on a physical Android device. Browser native operations were mocked; PDF geometry/cache tests reuse production methods with stubs.
PDF first release preserves page layout and supports navigation/zoom/resume; no OCR or PDF text selection/translation.
Native PDF/library state is device-local; existing export remains a notes/tags backup.
Automated checks do not establish Redmi K80 Pro FPS, memory usage, or zero crash behavior.
